---
{{yml}}
---

```{=html}
<div class="talk-container">
  <article class="talk-card">

    <!-- Header Section -->
    <header class="talk-header">
      {{#has_location}}
      <div class="talk-meta">
        <div class="talk-datetime">
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 448 512">
            <path d="M152 24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H64C28.7 64 0 92.7 0 128v16 48V448c0 35.3 28.7 64 64 64H384c35.3 64 64-28.7 64-64V192 144 128c0-35.3-28.7-64-64-64H344V24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H152V24zM48 192H400V448c0 8.8-7.2 16-16 16H64c-8.8 16-16-7.2-16-16V192z"/>
          </svg>
          {{time}}
        </div>
        <div class="talk-location">
          {{#online}}
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 512">
            <path d="M634.9 154.9C457.2-8.1 182.8-8.1 5.1 154.9c-6.5 6-6.9 16.1-.9 22.6l34.4 37.4c6 6.5 16.1 6.9 22.6.9c145.5-133.9 371.2-133.9 516.7 0c6.5 6 16.6 5.6 22.6-.9l34.4-37.4c6-6.5 5.6-16.6-.9-22.6zM320 320c-49.7 0-90.3 38.9-92.9 87.9c-.3 6.2 4.6 11.9 10.9 11.9h164.1c6.3 0 11.2-5.7 10.9-11.9c-2.7-49-43.3-87.9-92.9-87.9zM461.1 244.5c-77.5-71.4-198.7-71.4-276.2 0c-6.9 6.4-7.4 17.3-.9 24.2l34.2 36.6c6.4 6.9 17.1 7.4 24 1.1c46.3-42.4 118.3-42.4 164.6 0c6.9 6.3 17.6 5.8 24-1.1l34.2-36.6c6.5-6.9 6-17.8-.9-24.2z"/>
          </svg>
          {{room_label}} + online
          {{/online}}
          {{^online}}
          <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 384 512">
            <path d="M215.7 499.2C267 435 384 279.4 384 192C384 86 298 0 192 0S0 86 0 192c0 87.4 117 243 168.3 307.2c12.3 15.3 35.1 15.3 47.4 0zM192 128a64 64 0 1 1 0 128 64 64 0 1 1 0-128z"/>
          </svg>
          {{room_label}}
          {{/online}}
        </div>
      </div>
      {{/has_location}}
      {{^has_location}}
      <div class="talk-datetime">
        <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 448 512">
          <path d="M152 24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H64C28.7 64 0 92.7 0 128v16 48V448c0 35.3 28.7 64 64 64H384c35.3 64 64-28.7 64-64V192 144 128c0-35.3-28.7-64-64-64H344V24c0-13.3-10.7-24-24-24s-24 10.7-24 24V64H152V24zM48 192H400V448c0 8.8-7.2 16-16 16H64c-8.8 16-16-7.2-16-16V192z"/>
        </svg>
        {{time}}
      </div>
      {{/has_location}}
      <h1 class="talk-title">{{title}}</h1>
    </header>

    <!-- Body Section -->
    <div class="talk-body{{#multi_speaker}} talk-body--stacked{{/multi_speaker}}">

      <!-- Main Description -->
      <section class="talk-description">
        {{{abstract}}}

        <div class="talk-cta">
          {{#is_tutorial}}
          <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" class="btn-register" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Register for this tutorial
          </a>
          {{/is_tutorial}}

          {{#is_workshop}}
          <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" class="btn-register" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            Register for the workshop day
          </a>
          {{/is_workshop}}

          {{#slides_url}}
          <a href="{{slides_url}}" class="btn-slides" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            View slides
          </a>
          {{/slides_url}}
        </div>
      </section>

      {{#multi_speaker}}
      <!-- Speakers -->
      <div class="talk-speakers-grid">

        {{#speakers}}
        <!-- Speaker Profile -->
        <div class="speaker-profile">
          <img src="{{avatar_url}}" alt="{{name}}" class="speaker-img">
          <h2 class="speaker-name">
            {{name}}
          </h2>
          <div class="speaker-bio">
            {{{biography}}}
          </div>
        </div>
        {{/speakers}}

      </div>
      {{/multi_speaker}}

      {{^multi_speaker}}
      <!-- Sidebar -->
      <div class="talk-sidebar">

        {{#speakers}}
        <!-- Speaker Profile -->
        <div class="speaker-profile">
          <img src="{{avatar_url}}" alt="{{name}}" class="speaker-img">
          <h2 class="speaker-name">
            {{name}}
          </h2>
          <div class="speaker-bio">
            {{{biography}}}
          </div>
        </div>
        {{/speakers}}

      </div>
      {{/multi_speaker}}

    </div>
  </article>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<style>
#title-block-header {
  display: none !important;
}
</style>
```
